notes.title: About black screen during dialogue & camera spinning uncontrollably issues.
notes.content:
If your game shows you a black screen during dialogues or the view is spinning uncontrollably during combat then please try the following solutions:

1. Black screen during Dialogues.
Please try to play the game in full screen with a resolution of 1280 x 720.

2. Camera spinning uncontrollably.
Make sure that no controllers are connected to your PC while playing Panty Party.
Should this not solve the problem then try the following.
Go to "Options -> Keybinds" and remove the joystick keybinds for "Camera Pitch" and "Camera Yaw" by clicking the X button next to them.

We are sorry for the inconveniences and hope you are able to play without issues now.
